hook.name: HID Domain Registry Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook on an ETH/HID token pool that collects protocol fees on swaps via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta. For plain buy swaps (ETH→HID, no hookData or unapproved root), beforeSwap charges 1% of ETH input; for domain-registration buy swaps (hookData non-empty + inputAmount ≥ autoRegisterThreshold + root approved), beforeSwap charges a fixed REGISTRATION_FEE (0.0005 ETH). Sell swaps (HID→ETH) are charged 1% of ETH output via afterSwap. When a registration swap succeeds, afterSwap registers the domain encoded in hookData on-chain to tx.origin.
